$comment: Committed reductions for the legacy live-evidence matrix and the staged-artifact gates. The evidence producer (package/scripts/produce-evidence-inputs.ts) merges the coverage/gates/performance groups into the inputs it emits, and check-package-artifacts/release-gate load the packageArtifacts/releaseGate groups directly (default path or --reductions/PIXIE_REDUCTIONS_MANIFEST); nothing here is inferred at runtime. A reduction removes a live-matrix or publication requirement, it is not evidence that the retained behavior passes, and it is never reported as a pass.

approval.statement: The operator approved the breaking removal of the legacy Bun assistant and the lean live-evidence reductions recorded here. Each reduction removes a legacy live-matrix requirement; the retained feature remains a release requirement unless it is listed in optionalFeatures. No reduced row is recorded as passing.

reductionGroups.reason: Live FC/X matrix row is not produced by the lean artifact-only producer after the legacy Bun assistant removal. The retained behavior is covered by focused Go/controller/bridge tests, not by an independently exercised deployment. Compaction reserve (FC11), pi.tools.call (FC25/native tools) and session.prompt.resource (text resources) are among the operation-level reductions. The live-matrix requirement is reduced by explicit operator approval; the feature remains a release requirement unless separately listed as optional.

Exact working hints and request-specific UI cancellation are not available from the retained selected-Pi public API. Named reduction approved with the D4 reductions; the row is not presented as parity.
The editor read path (getEditorText() returns empty) is reduced; the write projection remains. Named reduction approved with the D4 reductions.

mcp.attach, adapter.status and pi.tools.list require a live Pi extension event bus the standalone sidecar cannot provide without starting a second adapter. Named reduction approved with the legacy removal.

Cross-boundary acceptance rows belong to the former legacy live matrix. The lean producer executes only staged-binary identity/configuration/readiness probes; the retained behavior is covered by focused Go/controller tests. The live-matrix requirement is reduced by explicit operator approval.

coverage.evidenceNote: FC01 is the only required coverage row the producer exercises. It records actual/live evidence for the staged-binary --version and doctor probes and, when a base URL is supplied, the readiness probe.

reductionGroups.reason: The original Gate 1-5 definitions existed only in the removed planning files and have no producer in the Go architecture. The gate live-matrix requirement is reduced by explicit operator approval.

fieldReductions.reason: The current Go engine has no separate decoded-buffer pipeline and no worker pool, so decoded/buffer memory, worker memory/PIDs/CPU/wall/output and scratch bytes/inodes cannot be measured. The producer records zero placeholders only alongside this approved reduction; no positive value is invented.
The produced performance evidence is a fresh-process startup probe, not a content-filled UI session fixture, so the legacy content-filled-UI requirement does not apply.

targetReductions.reason: The evidence job runs on linux/amd64 and does not emulate arm64. arm64 startup targets cannot be executed honestly in this job, so they are recorded as explicit reductions; arm64 performance remains unproven and is called out in the release checklist.

approval.statement: The operator approved reducing the staged-binary live-execution and full-host rows that the exact-commit evidence job cannot produce without a running host. This exempts only the listed rows; every structural archive, systemd, configuration and static command check stays mandatory, and no reduced row is recorded as passing.

reductionGroups.reason: The amd64 evidence job executes only native staged binaries; the arm64 version/doctor rows cannot run without an arm64 host. Readiness needs a running host or operator-supplied base URL, and lifecycle, uninstall and embedded-UI execution plus the full-host native-engine facade need a running service. Archive contents, entry structure and the native version/doctor rows stay mandatory; the native probes are consumed from the collector's BIN-PROBE assertions when present.

approval.statement: The operator approved reducing the release-gate inputs that require an actual publication or registry. This exempts only the listed rows; the static workflow publication-policy checks, source reachability from main, archive/binary identity and checksum consistency, and the controller-image evidence mapping stay mandatory, and no reduced row is recorded as passing.

reductionGroups.reason: Git tag and GitHub Release state, the published ghcr.io tag, registry provenance and SBOM attestations, registry image/platform digests and latest-promotion ancestry cannot exist until a real publication and registry are present. The staged manifest's local release ID, source commit, clean-tree flag, archive hashes and checksums remain mandatory; publication-only manifest fields and the non-native arm64 platform digest are reduced rather than invented.

namedReductions.reason: No observable working-message and no request-specific cancellation frame upstream.
getEditorText() returns empty; only the write projection remains.
Upstream blocks execution; the operation stays unsupported and fails closed.
No RPC representation for bounded text resources.
The legacy compaction reserve is not exposed by the selected-Pi RPC surface.
mcp.attach, adapter.status and pi.tools.list need a live Pi extension event bus.
